verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page: a secure, pre-built page hosted by Airwallex that accepts multiple payment methods through a single integration, with custom styling to match the merchant's site. The quickstart walks through an end-to-end sandbox payment using it, and Billing adds a hosted billing checkout page and Payment Links. So developers can send customers to a vendor-hosted checkout without building their own payment UI. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the hosted page itself is conversion-optimized (e.g. adaptive fields, local-currency display or conversion data tied to the page), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
